title: Hello 30A!
meta_description: Hello 30A is a 3BR condo in Blue Mountain Beach with a pool, private beach access, balcony, and stylish decor---perfect for a relaxing coastal getaway.
description_expanded:
ABOUT THE HOME: Hello 30A! Goodbye worries! The ultimate 30A vacation starts here with booking a stay at this luxurious unit in Redfish Village that will have you thinking you've just stepped into the pages of Southern Living Magazine. Welcome to this newly remodeled and beautifully decorated condo on the 3rd floor with features such as a fully equipped kitchen, a large dining table that seats 8, brand new furniture and a private balcony! The Blue Mountain community is known for its tranquility, many restaurants, and family atmosphere. The natural beauty of the sugar sand beaches, walking, biking trails and adventure await you

ABOUT THE AREA: Blue Mountain Beach is one of the 30A coastal communities that rests between Santa Rosa Beach and Grayton Beach State Park. This property is located in Red Fish Village, on 30A The complex borders the beautiful Redfish Lake and provides a boardwalk and overlook pavilion to explore the surrounding nature and soak in all of the scenery.

BEACH ACCESS: Private beach across street, about 3 blocks walk (has restrooms, \& showers) just east of Blue Mountain Regional public beach. There is some parking, coolers, wagons, and single inflatable toys are permitted, as well as kayaks and paddle boards.

ACCOMMODATIONS:
• Bedroom 1 -- 1 King, ensuite
• Bedroom 2 --1 Queen, ensuite
• Bedroom 3 --2 Queen, ensuite

PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS:
• Community seasonally heated pool
• Enclosed playground, yard area \& games
• Gas Grills -- Propane, community use
• Private beach
• Seasonal tram to beach
• Smart TVs in every bedroom with roku stick and YouTube TV
• Coffee Maker -- traditional and pod
• Full linen package: bedding \& bath
• Fully stocked kitchen
• Golf cart charging stations available for a fee through RFV (rental Golf carts)
\* Pack n play and boster seat in unit.

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

30A is a 20-mile stretch of beaches and coastal towns along Florida's famous Emerald Coast. From Seaside down past Laguna, you'll find white sands, azure waters, and laid-back vibes. This region takes a relaxed approach to oceanfront living, with boutique shops and local seafood on every main street. Each town along 30A has its own unique identity, so we encourage you to explore them all!

Local Attractions: The Big Chill 30A, Gulf Place Plaza, Camp Helen State Park, Henderson Beach State Park A, Village of Baytowne Wharf, Grayton Beach State Park, Alys Beach, Seaside Beach, Watercolor Beach

Home Truths:
- Unfortunately, pets are not allowed in this home. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- As of May 1, 2026, the owners' lounge, including the gym, will be restricted to owner access only.

Parking Details:
- 1 parking spot in the garage with overflow anywhere in the parking lot.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)

all: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
